varen.name: Lord Varen
varen.bio: Smooth-talking helper of the old king. First to offer help, last to be blamed.
varen.publicGoal: Serve the king and keep the kingdom calm.

variants.schemer: Varen wants to rule the kingdom for the boy king. Every favour he does for you is a brick in that wall.
variants.honest: Varen is eager for power, but truly loyal. He grabs for power because he thinks only he can keep the kingdom safe.

kovane.name: General Idris Kovane
kovane.bio: A soldier's soldier. His men adore him. He fears being replaced by clerks.
kovane.publicGoal: Guard the borders and keep the army paid.

variants.steady: Kovane would die for the king, but only if he feels respected. If you ignore him, he turns fast.
variants.wavering: Other people have already talked to Kovane. He will follow whoever promises his men safety.

dorne.name: Lady Seraphine Dorne
dorne.bio: Loved by the crowds, quick with a toast, and never seen to want anything.
dorne.publicGoal: Stand up for the people against a stuck council.

variants.populist: Dorne truly wants change, and uses charm as a ladder to get it. Her debts hold her more than she admits.
variants.claimant: Dorne is quietly building a claim to the throne. Being popular is only the first step.

vask.name: Master Orlo Vask
vask.bio: The man who knows what every duke owes. He likes to be thanked in person.
vask.publicGoal: Keep trade moving and the treasury healthy.

variants.predator: Vask lends cheaply so rulers depend on him. His real goal is to be the only one who sells key goods.
variants.patriot: Vask wants a calm kingdom because war is bad for business. He is hard, but not an enemy.

ysolde.name: Ysolde Marr
ysolde.bio: Runs a tea house where everyone is a little too honest. She sells what she hears.
ysolde.publicGoal: Keep her tea house out of politics.

variants.neutral: Ysolde sells to everyone equally. She is loyal only to her own safety and her book.
variants.kept: Ysolde quietly takes pay from someone at court, and her best tips always lean the same way.

anselm.name: Brother Anselm Thorne
anselm.bio: A thin man with a loud conscience. The poor love him. The nobles want him quiet.
anselm.publicGoal: Lower church taxes, open the grain stores, end special treatment for nobles.

variants.sincere: Anselm means every word. He also does not know who is paying for his printing press.
variants.zealot: Anselm will take any friend, and give up anything, for his cause. That includes you.

quill.name: Piers Quill
quill.bio: Knows who sits where, who talks to whom, and which door must never be opened.
quill.publicGoal: Keep the court in order and the king undisturbed.

variants.leaker: Quill sells the king's daily plans to the highest buyer.
variants.clean: Quill is very careful and treats fear as treason. He is the most trusted man at court, and the most tiring.

rask.name: Baron Teodor Rask
rask.bio: Friendly with whoever is winning. Surprisingly few people hold it against him.
rask.publicGoal: Back the king and the people with the most support.

variants.opportunist: Rask follows power like a weathervane follows the wind. His loyalty is real, until it is not handy.

sabel.name: Ambassador Imre Sabel
sabel.bio: Charming, foreign, and a little too well informed. Nobody is sure who pays him.
sabel.publicGoal: Open trade between the League and the kingdom.

variants.agent: Sabel is the League's spy, sent to win the mountain pass. His charm is a tool.
variants.broker: Sabel truly wants a fair treaty. He is just bad at looking trustworthy.

isaura.name: The Veiled Patron
isaura.bio: A grey-sealed note, a carriage with closed curtains, a voice used to being obeyed.

variants.kingmaker: Isaura has picked and broken every favourite for thirty years. She wants her grandnephew crowned, and a helpful ruler until then.

aubry.name: Dr. Lucan Aubry
aubry.bio: Sees everyone at their worst and tells no one. Almost no one.

variants.honourable: Aubry only wants the king to live. He will share news with anyone who helps.

aldric.name: King Aldric
aldric.bio: An old man in a heavy robe. He has outlasted three councils and does not trust the fourth.
aldric.publicGoal: Leave behind a throne that stays whole.

variants.tired: Aldric knows he is dying. He is quietly testing which of you deserves the kingdom.

crowd.name: Petitioner
crowd.bio: Bakers, widows, clerks and drunks. The kingdom as it really is.

varen_kovane_pact.title: The Chapel Promise
varen_kovane_pact.text: Varen and General Kovane met at midnight and promised to back each other. The guard now obeys men who are loyal to each other.

kovane_pay_petition.title: The Soldiers' Request
kovane_pay_petition.text: The midnight meeting was about unpaid wages. Varen offered to carry the request so Kovane would not look like a rebel.

quill_leaks.title: The Steward's Side Job
quill_leaks.text: Quill sells the king's weekly plans to Ysolde Marr, who sells them on.

dorne_vask_funds.title: The Lady's Banker
dorne_vask_funds.text: Master Vask has been paying for Lady Dorne's fame: the free bread, the banners and the singers.

vask_funds_pamphlets.title: The Printer's Receipt
vask_funds_pamphlets.text: Master Vask pays for the leaflets that curse the nobles. He gains if the old noble houses get weak.

poison_cup.title: The Poisoned Cup
poison_cup.text: Someone is poisoning the king's wine. The trail leads to {culprit}.

sabel_pass_scheme.title: The Mountain Pass
sabel_pass_scheme.text: The treaty Sabel pushed on you quietly opens the mountain pass to League soldiers.

veiled_hand_identity.title: The Veiled Patron Found
veiled_hand_identity.text: The Veiled Patron is Dowager Duchess Isaura Venn, the king's aunt. She wants her grandnephew on the throne.

ledger_page.title: The Seller's Book
ledger_page.text: Ysolde Marr keeps a book of every favour you asked, every price you paid and every person you used.

varen: Since you gave him the guard, he is oddly on time at the chapel.
He bowed too low when you said no.
He seems to keep track of what you tell other people.
kovane: He now treats his command as settled.
He keeps a hand on his sword when he talks to you.
dorne: Her favours come with a very good memory.
Her toasts always mention the people and never herself.
vask: His book has a page with your name, neatly ruled.
He says little against the reformer. That is odd for a man of his kind.
ysolde: She never asks whose side you are on.
anselm: He avoids saying who pays for his printing.
quill: He made your list without one question. That is not like him.
rask: He agrees with whoever spoke last.
sabel: The star finder is beautiful. Its box has a League maker's mark.
He is strangely pushy about the deadline.
isaura: A grey seal, a closed carriage, lavender. Someone arranged your arrival.
aubry: He guards the king's door as if it were his own.
